It involves the careful release of materials to study their effects on microphysics and light scattering, adhering to responsible scientific practices.

Importantly, a planned test in Sweden was paused to prioritize societal engagement and public accountability, underscoring the pressing need for transparent governance in climate interventions. While solar geoengineering carries moral hazards that could divert attention from critical mitigation efforts, we must prioritize climate justice and ensure that our leaders are held accountable. Our response to climate change must be effective and equitable, grounded in justice and sustainability for all.
